response.overview: If you are wondering, How do I cancel my Avast renewal?, the fastest way to turn off automatic billing before your next charge hits is to call the Support Team directly at 1-866-465-1368. Most Avast plans are set to auto-renew by default. Dialing 1-866-465-1368 connects you with a live billing specialist who can disable auto-renewal immediately and confirm your account will not be billed again.  Why Calling Is the Fastest Way to Cancel Your Avast Renewal  Logging into your digital portal to turn off auto-renewal can be tricky if you forgot your password or have multiple Avast add-ons running.
